title: Incorrect default permissions on the folder-level JavaScript directory in Nitro PDF Pro before 26.4 on Windows allow a…
description: Nitro PDF Pro versions before 26.4 on Windows have incorrect default permissions on the folder-level JavaScript directory. This flaw allows a local low-privileged user to execute JavaScript in the security context of another user, including administrators, by planting a script in the %ProgramData%\Nitro\PDF Pro\CV\JavaScripts directory. The script executes automatically when the application is launched by the victim.
